temples.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple

dress_code.men: Dhoti-Kurta or Traditional Kurta-Pyjama (Western jeans/pants restricted during Sparsh Darshan)
dress_code.women: Saree, Salwar Kameez with Dupatta (Western attire/sleeveless not permitted for Garbhagriha)
dress_code.strictness_level: High (Strict for Mangala Aarti & Sparsh Darshan)
dress_code.footwear_policy: No shoes or leather accessories (belts, wallets) allowed inside security perimeter

customs_and_etiquette: Mobile phones and electronic gadgets must be deposited in digital lockers at Gate 4 or Ganga Dwar
Offerings must strictly be purchased from verified temple prasad counters
Aarti timings: Mangala Aarti (03:00 AM), Bhog Aarti (11:15 AM), Sandhya Aarti (07:00 PM), Shringar Aarti (09:00 PM)

temples.name: Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple

dress_code.men: Dhoti with Angavastram or Kurta with formal trousers (Jeans, lungis, shorts strictly prohibited)
dress_code.women: Saree or Half-Saree or Churidar with Dupatta (Leggings, sleeveless, and western dresses banned by HC order)
dress_code.footwear_policy: Strictly barefoot inside temple premises; chappal stands located at East and South gopurams

customs_and_etiquette: Strict ban on mobile phones inside premises (Court mandated); cloak rooms available at towers
Non-Hindus permitted up to the outer corridors, not inside Garbhagriha

temples.name: Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple

dress_code.men: Bare torso (no shirts/vests) with pure cotton Dhoti (Mundu); Angavastram wrapped around waist
dress_code.women: Traditional Kerala Saree or Set-Mundu (Salwar suits and modern western wear prohibited inside inner sanctum)

customs_and_etiquette: Only devotees practicing Hinduism are permitted inside inner sanctum
Dhotis available on rental/purchase at North and East entrance counters
Strict silence observed near the Ananthasayanam darshan doors

temples.name: Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple)

dress_code.men: Modest attire covering shoulders and legs; Head must be fully covered with Rumal / Patka / Turban
dress_code.women: Modest attire covering shoulders and full legs; Head must be fully covered with Dupatta / Scarf
dress_code.footwear_policy: Shoes and socks deposited at Joda Ghar; feet must be washed in holy water channel before entry

customs_and_etiquette: Strict prohibition of tobacco, alcohol, and intoxicating substances in the entire heritage zone
Photography allowed only in the outer Parikrama; prohibited inside Sanctum Sanctorum
24/7 Guru Ka Langar open to all humanity regardless of caste, creed, or faith
temples.best_visiting_hours: 04:00 AM (Palki Sahib ceremony) or 10:00 PM (Sukhasan ceremony)

temples.name: Venkateswara Swamy Temple (Tirumala)

dress_code.men: White Dhoti with Uttariyam / Kurta Pyjama (T-shirts, Bermudas, and Western jeans rejected at Vaikuntam queue)
dress_code.women: Saree or Half-Saree or Punjabi Dress with Dupatta properly pinned
dress_code.footwear_policy: No footwear within the 4 Mada Streets and temple complex

customs_and_etiquette: Govinda nama chant encouraged in queue complexes
Laddoo Prasadam token verification linked to Aadhaar/Passport ID
Electric vehicles and eco-friendly transit only on the holy hill
temples.best_visiting_hours: Subject to Special Entry Darshan (SED) / Divya Darshan time-slots

temples.name: Ramanathaswamy Temple (Rameshwaram)

dress_code.men: Dhoti or formal trousers with shirt (Wear change of dry traditional clothes after 22 Theerthams holy bath)
dress_code.women: Saree or Salwar Kameez (Dry clothes mandatory after theertham snanam before sanctum entry)

customs_and_etiquette: 22 Sacred Theertham wells snanam is customary before presiding deity darshan
Changing rooms available immediately after 22nd theertham (Kodi Theertham)
